text:
Maya: Quick lunchtime plan — hill reps at Sunset Stairs today? 12:15pm meet at the lobby. 3x6 hill sprints + easy jog back. Then optional crag potluck at 6pm for whoever's free? :mountain: :tada:
Jon: In. How long's the hill? pace?
Maya: About 200m, steepish. Goal is quality not time — ~90s rest. Plan:
```
12:15 meet lobby
12:20 warmup jog (10min)
12:30 3x6 reps (walk back recovery)
12:50 cool down
```
Keiko: @Maya is it ok for a bouldering-first day? I've got a slightly tweaked ankle — would scaling down be fine?
Maya: Totally — do 2 reps or swap for stair bounding. Or just come for warmup + jog. No one left behind. :heart:
Alex: I'll bring peanut butter bars for the potluck. Need me to grab plates? :muscle:
Sam: Count me in for carpool to the crag at 5:15 from the office. 2 seats. DM me if you want in. 🚗
Lunchbot: Reminder: Company Lunch Window active 12:00–1:00. If you're late, add to calendar #lunch-walks
Jon: Sweet. Anyone want to try a little timed rep? Or keep it chill.
Keiko: Chill for me pls. Maybe meet after work to spot at the crag. I'll bring a salad.
Maya: Awesome. See y'all at 12:15. @Alex thanks for bars. Might need a yoga strap as makeshift bandage lol :grimacing:
